notes: All metal trims, straps, hinges, brackets, caps and chains are black forged iron (materials swatch 'Black Iron'), not the brass/gold the kit sheets show. Gold appears only as thin inlay inside carved Ledger inscriptions and oath-marks.
Walls are 1 m thick and battered 8 degrees inward on the outer face only; every wall piece is one 3 m module wide and one 4 m storey tall.
Door openings are 2 x 3.2 m centred in a 3 m wall, leaving 0.5 m jambs that the oath-mark doorposts fill.
Spec-vs-sheet: 'Ledger Trim - End Cap' is labelled 0.5 x 0.0 m; spec wins, it matches the 0.5 m straight-run band: 0.5 x 0.5 x 0.5 m.
Spec-vs-sheet: 'Ledger Trim - Corner (90°)' is labelled 1.0 x 2.0 m (each wing); a 2 m tall corner cannot join the 0.5 m band, so it is 1.0 m wings x 0.5 m tall.
Spec-vs-sheet: 'Outer Corner (90°)' and 'End Cap (Wall Termination)' are labelled 3.0 x 4.0 m but drawn (and used on kit-assembly) as narrow piers; they fill the 1 m wall thickness, so 1 x 4 x 1 m.
Spec-vs-sheet: 'F. Wide Window (Triple Mullion)' is labelled 3.0 x 1.0 m, wider than any opening a 3 m wall can hold; it is fitted to the 2 m window opening (2.0 x 1.0 m glazing band).
Window inserts drop into the standard 2 x 2 m window opening; the slit and wide windows bring their own stone infill to fill it.
